_note: Evergreen editorial seed pool for noize, written by Claude on 2026-11-05 for owner review. Tips, ideas, real tools (homepage links only) and generic opportunities. No news: news only comes from the brand's listed feeds. Edit freely.

items.title: Mute the algorithm for a week
items.summary: Pick music by hand: record shops, friends, radio.

items.title: Start a zine or newsletter about one scene
items.summary: Document what is happening near you.

items.title: Listen to a whole album before you judge a single
items.summary: Albums are built to be heard in order. Give the full thing one uninterrupted listen first.

items.title: Follow the credits, not just the artist
items.summary: Find the producers, writers and session players behind a song you love and listen to what else they made.

items.title: Go to a gig for a band you have never heard
items.summary: Small rooms reward curiosity. Go early and stay for the support act.

items.title: Start a listening club that plays one album a week
items.summary: One album, one evening, one rule: no phones. Talk about it after.

items.title: Build a playlist that tells the story of one city
items.summary: Pick ten songs that sound like where you live and sequence them like a walk.

items.title: Swap three songs with someone who hates your taste
items.summary: Each of you picks three songs for the other. You both have to finish them.

items.title: Bandcamp
items.summary: Buy and stream music straight from artists and labels.

items.title: Discogs
items.summary: A database and marketplace for releases, pressings and credits.

items.title: Songkick
items.summary: Follow artists and get alerts when they play near you.

items.title: Play an open mic night
items.summary: Most towns have one. Sign up for one song and see how it feels.

items.title: Volunteer at a local venue or festival
items.summary: Volunteers often get in free and meet the people who run the scene.
